title: At least four killed in Kyiv after massive Russian drone and missile attack – Ukraine war live
summary: Twelve-year-old girl among those killed in massive Russian drone and missile bombardment on Kyiv The EU has agreed to move forward with plans for a drone wall at the heart of its eastern defences as momentum grows for a €140bn loan to Ukraine based on Russian frozen assets. After a meeting with ministers from 10 mostly central and eastern European member states plus Ukraine, the EU’s defence commissioner, Andrius Kubilius , said a drone wall to protect against incursions from the skies was an immediate priority and core element of the bloc’s eastern flank defences. If you are using air, and air missiles from your air fighter to shoot the drone, then you are using … [a] missile which costs 1m to kill the drone which costs 10,000. Continue reading...
